notes: Prices in JPY from SNKRDUNK. This is run10, collected 2026-09-18 (Friday) via the built-in browser pane, ~6.5 hours after run9 (same JST calendar day). Listings filtered to 販売中のみ (for-sale only); top-20 cheapest active listings taken per grade, with a 15% cutoff above the lowest listing (threshold = lowest * 1.15) splitting them into within_15pct vs excluded_over_15pct. The site's 安い順 (cheapest-first) sort was applied via the JS native-setter workaround and verified via screenshot (no SOLD-badge leakage) before extracting the top 20; the checkbox for 販売中のみ sometimes reset the sort back to 新着順 after being checked (seen on Card 5), requiring the sort fix to be re-applied. recent_completed_sales are the most recent ~15-20 sales-history entries per grade, oldest-to-newest, filtered by the 状態 grade pill on the card's 売買履歴 section (each grade-pill click was verified via re-extraction to ensure the correct grade's rows were returned). PSA10 population/gem-rate sourced from altema.jp (pokekachi) for the 5 established cards, all re-verified unchanged from run9 (10846/88.0%, 20026/88.7%, 80321/86.9%, 8102/81.5%, 49275/86.6%). image_url reused from the skill's cached table for all 11 cards. psa_tier_status omitted this run (JST is Friday, not Monday; the weekly PSA Value-tier check runs Mondays only). HEADLINE FINDING THIS RUN: both M6a cards that gained their first-ever PSA10 listings in run9 (Card 7, ミュウex SAR, and Card 10, ピカチュウex SAR day version) have now had those single ¥12,980 listings SOLD (both '5時間前' at the time of this run), confirming genuine completed PSA10 transactions for these newly-released cards rather than stale/unsold listings. Card 7 now shows 2 confirmed PSA10 sales total (¥9,700 on 09/16, then ¥12,980 today - a rising trend), and Card 10 shows its first-ever PSA10 sale at ¥12,980 matching its prior listing price exactly. Neither card has a replacement PSA10 listing yet, so both PSA10 tiles read 出品待ち (no active listings) again - this reflects a between-listings gap, not a stalled market; if anything it demonstrates real PSA10 demand converting into sales just three days after this expansion's release. None of the six M6a cards (including 7 and 10) have gained altema.jp PSA10 population data yet, which is expected since population figures require a batch of completed PSA gradings to register and lag well behind the first one-off completed sales. The other four M6a cards (Gengar ex, Jirachi ex, Mewtwo ex, night-version Pikachu ex) remain fully PSA10-empty, unchanged. Across the six M6a cards, A-grade lowest-listing floors drifted upward almost across the board vs run9 (Cards 6, 8, 9, 10 all up; Card 11 ¥14,500 with no run9 comparison point captured; Card 7 also up per its note) - a broad, mild firming of A-grade pricing for this expansion on day 3 post-release, even as PSA10 pricing (where present) is comparatively volatile. A-grade sales turnover remains very active (minutes-to-hours-old) across all six M6a cards. Among the five established cards vs run9: (1) Card 1 (ピカチュウVMAX CSR) PSA10 lowest listing jumped sharply to ¥29,500 from run9's ¥28,000, while its A-grade held steady at ¥16,000 with no A-grade sale in about 3 weeks (04/18-08/15 gap flagged again). (2) Card 2 (ピカチュウex SAR, SV8) held exactly steady at PSA10 ¥72,000 and A-grade ¥59,000, with no A-grade sale since 08/28 - the quietest of the five established cards this run. (3) Card 3 (ブラッキーex SAR) PSA10 partially rebounded to ¥72,500 from run9's sharp drop to ¥71,000, though still below run8's ¥73,000 - both PSA10 and A-grade (steady at ¥47,980) continue to show very active sales turnover, the most liquid of the five established cards. (4) Card 4 (ゲンガーVMAX SA): the long-standing listings-vs-sales divergence narrowed further - PSA10 lowest active listing eased to ¥325,000 from run9's ¥329,000, drifting toward (but still well above) the ¥280,000-300,000 sales cluster; A-grade remains thin at a single ¥335,500 listing with no new sale since 06/29. (5) Card 5 (名探偵ピカチュウ プロモ) PSA10 eased to ¥41,500 from run9's ¥42,300; A-grade held steady at ¥27,000 lowest, but its most recent sales (¥26,500-28,000 from 09/14 onward) have dropped noticeably below the late-Aug/early-Sep sales cluster, suggesting mild A-grade softening even as the listing floor hasn't moved yet. pokeca-chart.com index figures are unchanged from run9 (PSA10 index 113,619 yen: day -1.7%, month -23.7%, year +16.5%; raw/美品 index 52,380 yen: day +0.1%, month -4.1%, year +28.6%; data_range still ending 2026/09/17) - this is expected same-calendar-day behavior per the skill's note 1c (the index's data_range only advances once per day), not a stale or failed fetch. Volume-overlay reads this run: PSA10 index transaction-count bars (1M view) were spiking/volatile rather than trending in one direction - high early in the window, a trough, then a pronounced single-day spike (the tallest bar) around the third week, a smaller secondary spike about a week later, then moderate levels in the most recent 2-3 days. Raw/美品 index transaction-count bars peaked early-to-mid in the window, dipped through the middle, then rose again toward the most recent 1-2 days (among the tallest bars in the window) even as the average price line fell sharply over that same final stretch - an uptick in raw-grade trading activity accompanying the price decline.
